behavioral_intents: Attackers register scheduled tasks via PowerShell with elevated privileges and logon/startup triggers to achieve persistence.

Detect shell interpreters (cmd, PowerShell, etc.) initiating outbound connections to public code-hosting and paste-bin services, a common vector for downloading and executing malicious payloads or exfiltrating data.
Detect UAC bypass attempts via COM handler registry hijacking by modifying the mscfile shell command registry path to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges.
